confirmed: XRP is about $0.955 early Tuesday, roughly flat over 24 hours (CoinGecko, about +0.4% to +0.7% depending on the endpoint) and about 12% lower than 7 days ago (CoinGecko rolling 7-day change; $0.9544 last trade on Kraken, Kraken 24h range $0.9418 to $0.9765). It closed Monday at about $0.955 (CoinGecko daily close), still above Saturday's low of about $0.89, its lowest since November 2024. It is down about 26% over 30 days (CoinGecko). FXStreet's Tuesday note puts XRP well below its 50-, 100- and 200-day averages with RSI near 25, in oversold territory; oversold is not a signal that a bottom is in.

Bitcoin is about $64,200 to $64,900 early Tuesday, still near the four-month low of about $62,000 hit over the weekend and down for six straight weeks (Investing.com, CoinGecko). US stocks fell Monday (Nasdaq −2.49%, S&P 500 −1.92%), and the Crypto Fear and Greed Index read 12 as of 00:00 UTC Nov 17 (KuCoin daily report). Markets are pricing a 25 or 50 basis point Fed hike in December (CME FedWatch via Investing.com). Strategy said Monday it bought 485 BTC for about $33M (Investing.com).

Evernorth (Nasdaq: XRPN), the Ripple-backed XRP treasury company, reported cumulative write-downs of about $505M on its pre-listing XRP, carrying 346 million XRP at $342M at the end of September, nearly 60% below its original recorded value (about $2.44 per XRP on average) (CoinDesk, Nov 17, from its first quarterly report filed Nov 13). This is an accounting impairment that its rules do not let it reverse when prices recover; it does not mean Evernorth sold XRP. XRPN closed Monday down 5%.

US spot XRP ETFs had a net outflow of about $19.13M for the week of Nov 9 to 13, the largest weekly outflow since March 2026 (TokenPost, Bitcoin.com News). Early Monday Nov 16 data is partial: CryptoKeyhole, which reads issuer holdings files, shows Canary's XRPC down about 5.2M XRP (about $5.0M) and 21Shares' TOXR flat, with Bitwise and Franklin still to report as of 05:35 UTC Nov 17; CryptoETF.today shows no net flow for Bitwise's XRP fund Monday. Cumulative net inflows since launch remain about $1.79B and combined net assets about $1.15B (TokenPost, as of Nov 15).

Binance's XRP futures open interest was about $325.7M on Nov 16, down about 81% from roughly $1.7B at its July 2025 peak and the lowest since November 2024 (CryptoQuant data via The Crypto Basic, Nov 17). On-chain analyst Darkfost says whale net outflows of XRP from Binance have exceeded $127M since Nov 10, about $21M on Monday alone (CoinNess, Nov 17); exchange outflows are often read as holding demand, but they do not show who moved the coins or why. Lower open interest means less leverage, not necessarily less selling.

Ripple's Nov 16 Swell 2026 recap says the company expects to exit 2026 approaching a $900M annualized product revenue run rate with more than 1,700 institutions using Ripple (Ripple, Official; company figures, not audited). It says the proposed XRPL Single Asset Vault and Lending Protocol remain subject to validator approval. RLUSD supply is about $2.80B, ahead of PayPal's PYUSD at $2.63B (DefiLlama via Bitcoin.com News, Nov 16).

On the XRP Ledger, the proposed native lending amendment has 22 of 35 trusted-validator votes and the SingleAssetVault amendment it depends on has 23; each needs 29 held for two straight weeks, so neither is live and there is no activation date (CoinDesk, Nov 12). Separately, XRPL developers will reset Testnet and Devnet from 8 to 9 p.m. ET on Nov 25 after a server failure, wiping test accounts; the main XRP Ledger, real XRP balances and transaction history are not affected (TokenPost, Nov 14).

Binance has reopened withdrawals on 87 networks, including LTC and NEAR, and says it plans to restore all remaining withdrawal services before next weekend (TokenPost, Nov 13). XRP withdrawals were not among the paused tokens in its latest list.

Ripple's Oct 27 partnerships still stand but are mostly plans: BNY now supports XRP and RLUSD custody, while direct RLUSD mint/redeem at BNY is subject to approvals (The Block, Cointelegraph). Robinhood plans to use RLUSD on the XRP Ledger for institutional settlement through Bitstamp and to add RLUSD to its app later in 2026, with no start date or volume announced (Ripple, CryptoSlate). Separately, Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin supply has passed PayPal's PYUSD, about $2.80B vs $2.63B per DefiLlama, making it the seventh-largest stablecoin (Bitcoin.com News, Nov 16); RLUSD growth is not the same thing as demand for XRP.

At Ripple's Swell 2026 event, CEO Brad Garlinghouse said Ripple's large XRP holdings do not give it control of the XRP Ledger: Ripple runs one of the 35 validators on the recommended list, and holding XRP carries no voting weight (DailyCoin, Nov 10). Ripple CTO Emeritus David Schwartz disclosed on Nov 9 and 10 that his own holdings are down from about 26M XRP to about 3M over years of pre-arranged sales (crypto.news); that is a personal disclosure, not a Ripple sale.

Ripple's November escrow cycle is complete: 1 billion XRP was released at 00:00 UTC Nov 1, and Ripple re-locked 700 million XRP in new escrows, leaving 300 million XRP outside escrow, the same pattern as September and October (TokenPost, Coinpaper, Whale Alert). That does not show the 300 million were sold. The next release is due Dec 1.
not_confirmed: The CLARITY Act has not passed the Senate: the 'Senate Banking Committee advances CLARITY Act 15 to 9' posts recycle a May 14, 2026 vote, and the full Senate then failed to advance it 49 to 50 on Sept 15. 'Trump signs crypto bill' posts are false. 'U.S. has signed a bill to replace FedNow with a next-generation payment system powered by XRP' and 'RealToken on XRP Ledger will unlock $650 trillion on Nov 14' posts are false; no such law or unlock exists. '$28,000 per XRP' price predictions and 'if you hold 500+ XRP you might already be a millionaire' posts are speculation with no source. 'Convert your funds into XRP as banks go cashless' and 'get money out of the bank / financial reset' posts are engagement bait with no official basis. 'Whales now control nearly 74% of supply' does not match the latest Santiment figure of about 68.5% for 10M+ XRP wallets. BlackRock's appearance at Swell is a digital-assets director on an asset-manager panel, not a BlackRock XRP deal. No outlet confirms the '$60 billion' or '$73 billion in XRP transfers overnight' posts or the 'Trump met with Ripple' posts. 'XRP hit $37,000 on Bybit' posts have no evidence; XRP trades under $1 on every major venue. 'The Fed is being told to stand down as XRP gets the green light' has no basis. 'Reset is live' countdowns, 'QFS card' help desks, airdrops and move-your-coins or message-me-for-a-guide offers fit common scam patterns. 'North Korea's $6.3 billion XRP heist' posts are wrong: the $6.3B was taken from Binance hot wallets across many networks and assets, not XRP alone. 'XRP shorts on Bitfinex surge 652.89% to 468.2 MILLION' does not match Bitfinex's public margin data. 'Central banks agreed on a $5,000 set price for XRP' has no source. 'Explosive Goldman Sachs connection to XRP' is a teaser for a video with no document. 'Bloomberg spotlights XRP in 10 early races' misreads a Bloomberg election headline about House districts. 'Garlinghouse confirmed Ripple will become a major SWIFT shareholder by Nov 24' has no source. '$196.88 per XRP within days' posts label themselves rumors and give no basis. 'Bank of America announces an official large-scale partnership with Ripple' posts are false: neither company has announced one; BofA's documented link is as a connected bank in Ripple Treasury's (GTreasury) software gateway, not an XRP deal. 'Warren says the CLARITY Act will blow up the economy' recycles a May 2026 committee-hearing quote, not new news. 'Trump XRP payment claims, Nov 22' has no source. 'A $60 trillion bank just said which one it wants, XRP or XLM' is a video teaser with no named bank or document. 'Trump has signed an order opening 401(k)s to crypto' posts this weekend are not new: no new order was signed; the pending step is the Labor Department's final 401(k) alternatives rule, under White House review since Nov 5. '99.5% chance of XRP at $3,300 per coin, insane SEC filing' is a video teaser that names no filing. 'Frustrated XRP investors threatening to sell everything once they break even' is commentary, not data. 'Nearly $83 billion in XRP transfers recorded overnight' posts name no source or on-chain tracker, and follow the same template as earlier '$60 billion' and '$73 billion' posts. 'CNBC calls XRP the hottest crypto trade of the year' clips recycle a Jan 6, 2026 CNBC Power Lunch segment, when XRP was near $2.40. 'Kevin Warsh officially sworn in as Fed Chair' is old news: he took office May 22, 2026. 'Fed XRP settlement testing' and '20% XRP burn' claims have no source. 'Former Ripple employee says this is where millionaires are made' names no one. 'ETF clients buy $3 million of XRP, bringing ETF net assets to $1.43 billion' is contradicted: XRP ETFs had about $10.4M of outflows on Nov 9 and net assets near $1.24B. 'XRP Ledger introduces quantum-proof accounts' overstates a draft roadmap design that is not live. 'Senator Van Hollen will not vote for the CLARITY Act' is not new: he opposed it in May and voted no on Sept 15. 'Former Goldman Sachs analyst warns $0.30 is next' names no one. 'A newly activated wallet received $167.7 million of XRP' gives no transaction or source. 'Ripple's founder dumped nearly all his XRP' posts misstate a real disclosure: David Schwartz is a former CTO and XRP Ledger co-architect, not Ripple's founder, and says he still holds about 3M XRP plus Ripple stock. 'Kazakhstan's central bank invested $100 million in crypto funds, including XRP' is half right: the roughly $100M fund allocation is reported (Bloomberg via crypto.news), but no report names XRP. 'Brad Garlinghouse says long-term XRP holders will be very happy, something big may be coming' gives no date, video or source. 'A valuation report says 500 XRP could be worth $1.1 million by 2028' names no report, implies about $2,200 per XRP, and is attached to a token promotion. '$280 million of certified diamonds tokenized on XRP' is recycled from February. 'A former SWIFT engineer predicts a $100 to $250 XRP repricing in 2027' names no engineer and gives no basis; it is a prediction, not news. 'Ripple Mint launches' posts dated this week recycle a July 23, 2026 Ripple announcement. 'Global reset' and 'XRP reset' posts are wrong about the main ledger: the only reset scheduled is for the XRPL Testnet and Devnet developer networks on Nov 25, and real XRP on mainnet is not affected. 'Raymond James disclosed XRP ETF holdings in its 13F' is unverified: no outlet reports it and the 13F summaries we checked do not show an XRP ETF position. 'Trump just mentioned XRP on live television' clips name no program; the only November TV interview we found is his 60 Minutes interview, and no outlet reports an XRP mention. 'Bitwise just bought $13.25M of XRP' misdescribes ETF flows: Bitwise the firm does not buy for itself, its XRP ETF showed no net flow on Nov 12, and the group had a $1.09M outflow on Nov 13. 'The Department of Energy is building XRP Ledger apps for energy trades' is reported only by crypto outlets citing unnamed 'details of the federal initiative'; we found no DOE announcement. 'RLUSD just flipped XRP' is false: RLUSD is about $2.8B in market value versus about $63B for XRP. 'An unknown entity now holds $2.77 billion of XRP, the 8th-largest account' recycles a Sept 26 post made when XRP was about $1.54; at today's price that wallet's roughly 1.8B XRP is worth about $1.7B, and the XRPSonar tracker labels the address as Robinhood (not confirmed by Robinhood). 'Robinhood just picked the XRP Ledger, this could change everything' video teasers repackage the Oct 27 Ripple-Robinhood partnership; RLUSD settlement on the XRPL is planned with no start date. 'How much longer until $100 XRP? The question isn't if, it's when' is hype with no basis; XRP is under $1. 'Trump just mentioned XRP on live television' and 'Bitwise just bought $13.25M of XRP' posts were reposted again this weekend with no new evidence. Details are in the rumors section. 'The upcoming XRP god candle will shock the world' is a hype post with no source or basis. 'Ripple has been selling $300 million of XRP month after month for 14 years' is wrong on the timeline: the monthly escrow began in December 2017, and recent months show 300 million XRP left outside escrow after each 1 billion release, which does not by itself show it was sold. 'Whales just scooped up $71 million of XRP in one day' recycles a Nov 11 report of about 65 million XRP bought over four days, before XRP fell below $1. 'Jeonbuk Bank just dropped SWIFT for Ripple Payments and is using XRP' repackages an Aug 18 partnership; the settlement asset was never disclosed.
legend: Published by Ripple, a partner company, or a regulator about itself.
General financial press such as Reuters or Bloomberg.
Established crypto newsrooms such as CoinDesk, The Block, CryptoSlate.
Commentators, influencers and post summaries on X, blogs or video.
A claim of fact or future event with no named source.
Primary document, or a newsroom report with named sources or data.
Credible outlet relaying third-party data or company plans not yet delivered.
Partly true, but the conclusion drawn goes beyond the evidence.
No corroboration found. Treat as opinion.
Available evidence points the other way.

claims.claim: JUST IN: Wells Fargo, one of America's largest banks, has reportedly disclosed exposure to the Bitwise $XRP ETF in its latest 13F filing.
claims.check: Recycled and misleading: the $9.18M Wells Fargo position was in its Q2 13F filed Aug 14 (CoinTurk, GFdaily, August). Its latest Q3 13F (as of Sept 30) lists only 787 shares, about $9,177 (Wall Street Friend, SEC 13F data). A 13F line can reflect client accounts, not a bank bet. Not new.
claims.check_title: Wall Street Friend: Bitwise XRP ETF 13F holders (Sept 30)

claims.claim: JUST IN: The XRP Ledger has activated a security fix closing a loophole that could have allowed unauthorized creation of new tokens. The upgrade is now live on Mainnet.
claims.check: Accurate but not new: the fix activated on Mainnet on Nov 4 and applies to issued tokens such as stablecoins, not native XRP; no exploit was confirmed (CoinDesk, Nov 5).
claims.check_title: CoinDesk: XRP Ledger closes bug that let approved token burners create new tokens (Nov 5)

claims.claim: JUST IN: US Labor Department's final 401(k) investment rule has reached the White House for review... including crypto and XRP
claims.check: Partly accurate: the DOL's final rule on alternative assets in 401(k) plans is at White House review (Private Wealth Daily, Bloomberg Law). It is asset-neutral: it does not name XRP and does not require any plan to offer crypto. No effective date yet.
claims.check_title: Private Wealth Daily: DOL final 401(k) alternatives rule reaches White House review

claims.claim: Just in: TODAY President trump is expected to sign the Genus act at 2:30pm. XRP is expected to hit $10 per coin
claims.check: False framing: the GENIUS Act (stablecoin law) was already signed in July 2025 (Wikipedia summary of the law). No signing is scheduled today, and the $10 figure has no source. No mainstream corroboration.

claims.claim: JUST IN: An $XRP Ledger developer reveals that XRP holders will GET PAID simply for being active on X, WITHOUT having to hold XRP anymore, starting NEXT WEEK!
claims.check: No named developer, no source and no announcement from Ripple, XRPL Foundation or X found. Treat as clickbait; do not connect wallets or follow links in posts like this. No mainstream corroboration.

claims.claim: JUST IN: The upcoming $XRP god candle will shock the world.
claims.check: A hype prediction with no source, data or date. XRP is about $0.95 and down about 15% on the week (CoinGecko). Copies appeared from several accounts. No mainstream corroboration.

claims.claim: Major Korean bank just DROPPED SWIFT for Ripple Payments. Jeonbuk Bank is now using $XRP to tap into the $150 trillion cross-border payments market.
claims.check: Not new and overstated: Ripple and Jeonbuk Bank announced the partnership on Aug 18 (Cointelegraph). The companies did not say whether transfers use XRP, RLUSD or fiat rails, and nothing says the bank dropped SWIFT. No mainstream corroboration of XRP use.
claims.check_title: Cointelegraph: South Korea's Jeonbuk Bank taps Ripple for cross-border payments (Aug 18)

claims.claim: $215M IN XRP MOVED AS PRICE CRASHED TO $0.89 — WHALE ACCUMULATION OR WALLET ROTATION?
claims.check: The transfers are real: Whale Alert flagged two 120M XRP moves on Nov 15 through unidentified wallets, with no exchange deposits seen (CryptoCompass). Whether it is accumulation is unknown; moving coins between wallets is not buying. Crypto-press corroboration only.
claims.check_title: CryptoCompass: XRP whales move 240 million tokens as price crashes to two-year low
